## Translation pull request

This repository accepts pull requests for translations only (files in `i18n/`). The AionCore source code is private.

**Language:** <!-- for example es, de, fr, ru, zh-CN -->

**Keys touched:** <!-- list the keys, or "all missing keys" -->

**Summary:** <!-- what changed and why -->

### Checklist

- [ ] I did not change any `{placeholder}`, `<tag>`, link or domain.
- [ ] I did not change the legal or consent keys without saying so in this description.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate-i18n.mjs` and it passes.
- [ ] I did not add character names, account names or any other personal data.

### Native speaker?

- [ ] Yes, I am a native speaker of this language.
- [ ] No, I am not (a reviewer will check it).

### Contribution terms

- [ ] I agree to the contribution terms in CONTRIBUTING.md.
